basis: development runs on scratch output (not analysed); details in develop_logs/notes/20261104_x3_prereg_log.md

changes.was: ControlNet residual multiplied by 0 (plain MDM), as in experiment 1
changes.now: ControlNet receives OmniControl's native zero hint; C0 = native unconstrained output, S = spatial guidance on that base
changes.why: the plain-MDM base is degenerate for the registered prompts (development: 0.1 s jerk 89 vs 6.8 m/s^3, 1.1 m travel in 9.8 s)

changes.now: env.reset generators seeded and element 0's stand.pkl state copied to every batch element
changes.why: get_batch draws the start sequence at random; runs did not share the registered initial state

changes.now: post hoc: W0 windows corrected toward goal minus the written-back shift; later frames rigidly shifted by the written-back root translation
changes.why: DART re-canonicalises its history each primitive; a world shift of the history shifts every later C0 frame by the same vector (development max error 1.5e-6 m). Only the root translation is written back

changes.now: native fp16 autocast, per-primitive gradient checkpointing
changes.why: fp32 replay of the C0 noise drifts 4.97 m; native autocast replays exactly (0.0 m), passing the registered 0.01 m replay gate
after G0's single policy primitive the chaotic noise-driven walk leaves C0's path, so later C0-defined goals lie 5-20 m away

changes.now: generation waits for the reviewed RAM gate (>= 20 GiB free); the gate is not bypassed
changes.why: E3/E4 OpenSim workers share the host

changes.now: confirm generates only the 20 non-pilot (task, seed) cells and reuses the 4 pilot cells; top_up generates only seed 42
changes.why: one generation per cell; DART outputs depend on batch composition at fp16 precision

changes.now: the confirm DART batch (40 S jobs) starts in parallel with the pilot; its outputs enter analysis only if the pilot gate admits every DART arm without change, otherwise it is regenerated
changes.why: S costs 60 s per optimiser step (300 steps, about 5 h per batch, launch-overhead bound at 8% GPU utilisation)

unchanged: tasks, seeds, offsets, arms otherwise, hypotheses, margins, inference, pilot gate, precision rule
